identity.inherits: F1-R4 public declaration paths and dispositions except for the one explicit TokensProviderFactory member correction in this manifest

dispositionCorrection.dependentFunction: languages.registerTokensProviderFactory remains retained and accepts the narrowed native TokensProviderFactory
dispositionCorrection.reason: Monarch is an accepted complete language-content cut; retaining this one union branch would make a cut type reachable from a retained factory

nativePresenceTypes.MonaPresence<T>: absent or present(T); canonical mapping for optional properties, optional methods and explicit undefined where null is not present
nativePresenceTypes.MonaNullable<T>: null or value(T); canonical mapping for explicit T | null where absence is not present
nativePresenceTypes.MonaNullish<T>: undefined, null or value(T); canonical mapping when all three source states exist
nativePresenceTypes.rule: Swift Optional convenience is allowed only when the source consumer cannot observe a distinction; the canonical declaration manifest always records absent, null and value separately
nativePresenceTypes.defaultArguments: omitted optional parameters use MonaPresence.absent; an explicit null is never encoded as omission

MonaArray<Element>.semantics: ordered integer-indexed mutable storage with shared alias identity; ordinary Swift Array is a copying convenience, not the canonical public type

MonaReadonlyArray<Element>.ownership: immutable ordered snapshot; conditionally Sendable when Element is Sendable
MonaReadonlyArray<Element>.semantics: no mutation API; bypassing the source readonly type through a JavaScript cast is outside the accepted typed Swift domain

MonaURIIdentityMap<Value>.mapping: the sole retained Map<Uri, Value> occurrence in MultiDocumentHighlightProvider
MonaURIIdentityMap<Value>.keyEquality: ObjectIdentifier of the exact MonaURI reference
MonaURIIdentityMap<Value>.iteration: insertion order; replacement preserves the existing key position and original key reference
MonaURIIdentityMap<Value>.consumerFact: wordHighlighter calls has and get with each editor model's URI; a different URI instance with equal components does not match a native JavaScript Map

MonaResourceMap<Value>.use: model registries, single-document highlight fallback and other Monaco ResourceMap ports
MonaResourceMap<Value>.prohibition: it cannot silently replace public MultiDocumentHighlightProvider Map semantics

MonaUInt32Buffer.mapping: Uint32Array in IEncodedLineTokens.tokens, SemanticTokens.data and SemanticTokensEdit.data
MonaUInt32Buffer.semantics: UInt32 length, indexed read and write, overlap-safe set and copy; shared alias mutation remains visible until the consumer releases the result
MonaUInt32Buffer.backgroundTransfer: background LSP decoding produces an immutable Sendable UInt32 transfer snapshot and materializes the canonical buffer on MainActor
MonaUInt32Buffer.wireRule: logical UInt32 values are encoded to the semantic-token DTO in explicit little-endian order

MonaStringRecord<Value>.ownership: @MainActor mutable reference type unless the source wraps it in Readonly
MonaStringRecord<Value>.keyOrder: canonical array-index keys 0 through 2^32-2 in numeric order, followed by other raw-UTF16 string keys in insertion order
MonaStringRecord<Value>.semantics: lookup, replacement, deletion and ordered enumeration; Swift Dictionary iteration is not an oracle

tuples.rule: fixed arity and positional meaning are represented by dedicated native value types

dynamicValueMappings.MonaJSONValue: raw-UTF16 JSON null, boolean, IEEE-754 number, string, array and object; used by LSP, host commands, serializable view state and inline-completion change hints
dynamicValueMappings.MonaCommandValue: native command payload union containing nullish scalars, MonaText, URI, Position, Range, Selection, ordered arrays, ordered records and a MainActor opaque box for in-process native commands
dynamicValueMappings.MonaOpaqueAttachment: @MainActor reference box for InjectedTextOptions.attachedData; identity and typed unboxing are retained
dynamicValueMappings.MonaCodeEnvironmentOverrides: typed first-access environment and host capability fields replace IEditorOverrideServices string-indexed unknown services
sourceSpecificRules: IEvent listener return values are ignored and map to Void; JavaScript thisArg binding is absent from Swift closures
CancellationToken callbacks map to Void closures and an explicit MonaDisposableStore; JavaScript thisArgs is absent
Uri, Position, Range and Selection type guards accept native Any and never apply JavaScript coercion
createMultiFileDiffEditor remains the H1-R typed MonaMultiDiffEditorView replacement
EditorOptions any holes map to their already frozen native computed option types
IDiffEditor.revealFirstDiff maps to Void because the pinned implementation schedules waitForDiff().then and returns undefined
IInlineCompletionChangeHint.data maps to MonaJSONValue because its public declaration requires JSON serializability
languages.Command.arguments and the async MonaCommandHost boundary map to MonaJSONValue arrays
in-process registerCommand, action run, keybinding commandArgs and editor trigger payloads map to MonaCommandValue
dynamicValueMappings.cutBoundary: JavaScript prototypes, property descriptors, Symbol keys, arbitrary service decorators, function-valued data and source-level casts remain within the accepted JavaScript runtime and source-compatibility cuts; retained editor behavior receives one of the explicit native mappings above

providerExecutionContract.directProviders: all direct Swift language provider protocols are @MainActor; invocation receives the live Mona model and can synchronously reenter live model APIs before returning
providerExecutionContract.providerResult: MonaProviderResult<T> has value(T), null, undefined and thenable(MonaThenable<MonaNullish<T>>) cases
providerExecutionContract.normalization: the provider function is invoked synchronously; every immediate or deferred completion is processed through the repository-owned MainActor MonaMicrotaskQueue before consumer code continues
providerExecutionContract.mutableResultAliasing: MonaArray, MonaURIIdentityMap, MonaUInt32Buffer and MonaOpaqueAttachment preserve the same reference until the specific consumer releases or disposes it; a later queued mutation is observable in the same relative turn as the Chrome probe
providerExecutionContract.lspAndHost: LSP decoding and H1-R async host callbacks receive immutable Sendable request or transfer values, never a live model or a non-Sendable direct-provider container
providerExecutionContract.publication: every async completion reenters MainActor through the existing session, request, model-instance and version gate before UI or model publication
forbidden: passing a live model, MonaArray, MonaURIIdentityMap, MonaUInt32Buffer or MonaOpaqueAttachment to a detached task
copying a mutable direct-provider result at completion and thereby erasing later same-turn alias mutation
processing an immediate ProviderResult inline in the provider's call stack

acceptanceOverrides.MonaNativeDeclarationManifest: adds canonical presence/nullability, container/reference identity, dynamic payload and direct-provider actor/scheduling mappings for every retained declaration path
acceptanceOverrides.C04: covers all 14 direct and 18 transitive external named types, 159 array forms, 3 tuples, 788 optional forms, 205 null-or-undefined forms, 28 any-or-unknown forms and the corrected 12 explicit member cuts
acceptanceOverrides.C06: covers direct-provider synchronous invocation, reentry, null versus undefined, immediate versus thenable completion, microtask order, mutable result aliasing, URI identity-map lookup and Uint32 semantic-token reuse
acceptanceOverrides.C09: strict-concurrency fixtures prove non-Sendable provider containers never cross actors and immutable LSP or host transfers always return through the complete validity gate
acceptanceOverrides.P11: measures provider normalization and container overhead without deleting the MainActor alias semantics

passRule: F1-R5 passes only when the candidate native declaration manifest is set-equal to all 434 corrected retained mappings, compile fixtures construct every presence and container shape, behavior traces match the pinned runtime cases, C04/C06/C09 and every applicable P11 cell pass, and no unresolved external type remains
